reason: I decide my sale a day or two before it starts, and I already paid for Facebook boosts this month. Signing up, waiting for my business name to be approved, then working out how to upload my customer list is too much to sort out in that window, so I'd just stick with Facebook and WhatsApp.
objection: I don't know how to get my customer numbers from my book and phone into this, and if the sender name approval takes days my sale will be over before the first SMS goes out.
would_change_my_mind: Someone from SMS Buddy setting it up for me on WhatsApp the same day: I send them my list as it is, they load it and the first message goes out under my shop name before the sale.
